title: Sacrifices on f7 and f2
line: The weakest squares in the opening, guarded only by the king.

steps.text: Early in the game, the pawn on f7 is guarded only by the king. Here the king also guards the queen on d8, which faces yours.
Take the pawn on f7 with your bishop, with check. The king must take it and leave the queen.
steps.hint: Your bishop already aims at f7.
steps.after: The king took the bishop, and nothing guards the black queen now.
A bishop and a pawn for the queen.

steps.text: Now for Black. White's queen on d5 has no guard, but your own bishop stands between it and your queen.
Move the bishop out of the way with check: take the pawn on f2.
steps.after: The king took the bishop, and your queen now sees the white queen.
Black gave a bishop and took the queen.

summary: Early on, the pawn beside the king has only the king to guard it. Take it with check, and the king must leave its post.
